body.x: The world’s largest IT exhibition, CES 2018 media days, Consumer Technology Show, celebrated its second day in Las Vegas, U.S., on Sunday, Jan. 7(local time).

Intel held keynote address on topics for data at the press conference. Intel CEO, Brian Krzanich introduced Intel True View for using a broad variety of Immerse Media of which technology brings the pixels into a 3D space.

When this technique applies to Immerse Media, the fans can experience sports games as if they are watching virtually at the desired location. Intel’s True View will apply to 30 PyeongChang Winter games.

Besides, Intel introduced Intel Studio, which can adapt Intel True View to the entertainment. Intel Studios is characterized to use volumetric technology, not just 3D motion capture. It has a realistic panoramic view because it captures the same scene from a 360-degree angle.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
